title: State the 16384-character per-text limit in the injected reviewer result-submission protocol
outcome: Reviewer children learn the per-field text limit of the structured review-result submission before they submit, so a long coverage note is split up front instead of being rejected and retried.
acceptance: The reviewer-mode result protocol that TermAl injects into delegated /review-code children states the per-text-field limit enforced by MAX_DELEGATION_REVIEW_RESULT_TEXT_CHARS (src/delegation_review_results.rs, currently 16 * 1024 characters) and the list limit MAX_DELEGATION_REVIEW_RESULT_LIST_ITEMS (200), or derives them from those constants, so the stated limits cannot drift from the enforced ones.
A test drives a submission whose single text field exceeds the limit and asserts the existing rejection names the field and the limit; no test pins the protocol text itself.
